meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按你的要求操作 Git:把改动按主题拆成多个原子提交、用 rebase/squash 改写分支历史,以及用 blame、bisect、reflog 追查某行或某次改动是谁、何时、为什么改的,并在回答里给出命令证据。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交改动、改写分支历史,或追查 Git 历史问题时触发;普通的代码编辑会跳过该技能。

say.text: 把我当前的改动按主题拆成几个提交
say.note: 先看完整 diff,再按组暂存并逐个提交

say.text: 这个文件第 20 行是谁改的?
say.note: 用 blame 定位,给出提交哈希和说明

say.text: 帮我把这几个 fixup 合并到对应提交
say.note: 用 autosquash 的交互式 rebase 改写历史

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude handles Git work on request: splitting changes into atomic commits, rewriting branch history with rebase/squash, and tracing who changed a line or commit, when, and why via blame, bisect, and reflog, citing the exact command evidence in its answer.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task needs a commit, a branch-history rewrite, or a git-history investigation; skipped for ordinary code edits.

say_en.text: Split my current changes into a few commits by topic
say_en.note: Reads the full diff, then stages and commits group by group

say_en.text: Who last changed line 20 of this file?
say_en.note: Uses blame and reports the commit hash and message

say_en.text: Squash these fixups into their target commits
say_en.note: Rewrites branch history with an autosquash rebase
